nodes.description: Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the implementation address used by the proxy.
Constant bytes32 storage slot holding the admin address authorized to upgrade the proxy.
Deploys the proxy, validates impl != 0 and writes implementation plus msg.sender as admin into raw slots.
Admin-only function that overwrites IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT with newImpl after checking msg.sender.
Admin-only function that overwrites ADMIN_SLOT with newAdmin after checking msg.sender.
View function returning the implementation address read from IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
Internal helper reading a bytes32 slot and truncating it to an address.
Internal helper returning the raw bytes32 value of a storage slot via sload.
Internal helper writing a raw bytes32 value into a storage slot via sstore assembly.
Internal function performing a raw delegatecall to the implementation address, forwarding all calldata.
Empty receive function accepting plain ether transfers.
Payable fallback that delegates any unmatched call to the implementation address.
Caller-controlled address used for admin assignment and authorization checks.
Raw assembly sstore writing arbitrary bytes32 values into slots.
Raw assembly delegatecall forwarding caller calldata to the implementation with full storage context.
Constructor parameter: initial implementation address.
Parameter of setImplementation: the new implementation address.
Parameter of setAdmin: the new admin address.
Parameter of _getAddress: storage slot key to read.
Parameter of _getSlotValue: slot to read with sload.
Local return variable of _getSlotValue holding the sload result.
Parameter of _setSlotValue: slot to write with sstore.
Parameter of _setSlotValue: value to write with sstore.
Parameter of _delegate: target address for the delegatecall.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read in the constructor and stored as the initial admin.
msg.sender is compared with ADMIN_SLOT to authorize implementation upgrades.
msg.sender is compared with ADMIN_SLOT to authorize admin changes.
impl is cast to bytes32 and written through _setSlotValue in the constructor.
newImpl is cast to bytes32 and written through _setSlotValue.
newAdmin is cast to bytes32 and written through _setSlotValue.
key is forwarded from _getAddress to _getSlotValue.
slot_get is the slot argument supplied to sload.
sload result is assigned to the value_get return variable.
slot_set is the destination slot of the sstore operation.
value_set is the value written by the sstore operation.
implementation__ is the target address passed to the delegatecall.
IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is passed as the key to _getAddress in the fallback path.
ADMIN_SLOT is passed as the key to _getAddress in the authorization checks.
setImplementation writes the new value into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
The constructor initializes IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
setAdmin writes the new value into ADMIN_SLOT.
The constructor initializes ADMIN_SLOT with msg.sender.
_setSlotValue supplies slot and value to the raw sstore operation.
_delegate executes the raw delegatecall to the implementation.
The delegatecall transfers control to arbitrary implementation code which can re-enter the fallback and rewrite storage slots.
The constructor calls _setSlotValue twice to initialize storage.
setImplementation calls _setSlotValue to overwrite the implementation slot.
setAdmin calls _setSlotValue to overwrite the admin slot.
setImplementation calls _getAddress to read the current admin for the check.
setAdmin calls _getAddress to read the current admin for the check.
_getAddress calls _getSlotValue to read the raw slot.
implementation() calls _getSlotValue to read IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
The fallback retrieves the implementation address and calls _delegate.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter impl only flows into the constructor's storage initialization and should be folded into the constructor function node.
newImpl is only used inside setImplementation to update the implementation slot, so it merges into that function.
newAdmin is only used inside setAdmin to update the admin slot, so it merges into that function.
key is the sole parameter of _getAddress and carries no independent semantics, so it merges into the helper function.
slot_get is the slot parameter of _getSlotValue and merges into that helper.
value_get is the return local of _getSlotValue and merges into the same helper.
slot_set is the destination slot parameter of _setSlotValue and merges into that helper.
value_set is the value parameter of _setSlotValue and merges into that helper.
implementation__ is the call target parameter of _delegate and merges into that function.
